text:
ash: Quick sync  we need a short deprecation playbook for v1->v2 that PM, SDK, and docs can reuse. Focus: examples, redirects, and customer comms.

mohit: agreed. I'll draft the playbook sections: timeline, snippet fixes, CI lint rules, and rollback plan.

bella: for snippets: replace any `client.v1.` or `ResponsesClientV1` imports, and prefer canonical model aliases (chat-v2, embed-lite-v2). I'll batch-fix the JS snippets.

ash: can someone confirm embed dims for `embed-v1-small` -> `embed-lite-v2`? need exact delta so we can warn about re-indexing.

mohit: embed-v1-small was 128 -> embed-lite-v2 is 256. note in the guide: "re-embed vectors or use a transformer adapter; do not mix dims".

release-bot: created issue #789: "v1->v2 deprecation playbook" and assigned @mohit @bella; added label "deprecation".

bella: CI idea: add a docs-only lint job that greps for `/v1/|ResponsesClientV1|embed-v1` and reports results. Make it advisory for 72h, then block. Also add a smoke test that runs sample snippets.

comms: we'll draft a short customer-facing notice: 2 lines + link to migration guide. Can we ship that concurrently with docs publish?

mohit: plan: publish migration guide Tue, advisory lint Wed, SDK backports Thu, redirects enabled (301 with Deprecation header) in 14 days, final removal after 30 days.

ash: include sample deprecation header in the guide:

```
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Location: https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
Deprecation: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 00:00:00 GMT
Link: <https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/v1-to-v2>; rel="documentation"
```

bella: I'll open PRs for snippets and tag SDK owners. Mohit, please include a migration matrix mapping host path -> v2 path and model aliases.

mohit: will do. also adding a short troubleshooting FAQ (common snippet errors, token/cors quirks).

ash: one more: scan archived blog posts and partner pages for hard-coded endpoints; add redirects where needed.

release-bot: linked PRs to issue #789 and scheduled a reminder for 7 days before redirect removal.

ash: thanks team  ping here when PRs are ready and I'll draft the announcement blurb for #announcements.
